svg.title: Quality–Cost Pareto Frontiers
svg.desc: Two scatter plots show Soft Semantic Score against mean successful-query tokens. Solid points are Pareto-efficient, pale points are dominated, and Full Context is a diagnostic point.

text.tspan: Soft Semantic Score versus mean successful-query tokens
Pareto status is computed within each panel; Panel B is diagnostic because Full Context used a different served-model identifier.
